original_test_intent: Read the selected ComputerSystem Memory collection and validate complete DIMM/resource membership, aggregate capacity and health as a bounded read-only inventory snapshot.
original_method: Resolve the advertised System Memory link, use trusted curl/jq to GET the bounded collection, validate resource type/count/unique member links and approved aggregate fields, and retain a redacted snapshot without changing memory state.
manual_activity: Provision the reusable secure Redfish runner, target-member policy, Memory schema and serial/part/locator redaction rules; no per-run confirmation or physical DIMM action is required afterward.
required_inputs: Expected population and aggregate capacity policy
Trusted TLS and least-privilege credential provider
safety_requirements: Reject inconsistent count or aggregate capacity
agent_execution_scope: Capture status/headers and restricted raw hash
Validate resource type, count, unique member links and pagination
Export redacted collection snapshot and no-mutation audit

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: curl/jq and GET fit the test, but the fixed System ID and `-k` are unsafe and raw pretty-printing does not fail on wrong type, count mismatch, duplicate members or missing capacity/health data.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With trusted TLS, follow the selected System's Memory link, require 2xx Redfish JSON, validate bounded collection count/unique members/pagination and approved capacity/health fields, then export only redacted inventory metadata.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Memory collection GET and 15/10 timing remain; no SystemId, member count, capacity total, health value or DIMM identity is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a schema-aware collection validator that reconciles count, unique member links and aggregate capacity while preserving privacy and state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces fixed identity, unsafe TLS/credentials and readability-only criteria with link, pagination, population, capacity/health and redaction validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Establishes collection completeness and aggregate state; detailed DIMM/member fields remain the following Memory_ID case's responsibility.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Management memory inventory may omit reserved capacity or represent logical resources. It does not test memory bandwidth, ECC injection, training or OS-usable memory.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK is equivalent if it preserves System/Memory links, certificate identity, count/Members/pagination and aggregate field evidence. Host memory tools can corroborate but cannot replace the BMC collection contract.
expected_evidence: Immutable BMC/System identity, firmware and Memory schema
HTTP status/content type and restricted raw response hash
Collection count, unique member links and pagination audit
Aggregate capacity/health validation and redacted locator summary

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master item, Memory collection path and GET consistently describe a read-only memory collection query. Security and acceptance gaps are execution-quality deficiencies, not competing source semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The collection purpose and path are explicit and can run after normal secure Redfish, schema/population and redaction configuration.

review_improvement: Upgrades a readable JSON dump into a population-, capacity- and health-aware Memory collection validation with privacy-safe evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Memory collection is useful only when the member set is complete and internally consistent. Duplicate or missing links can coexist with valid JSON, and aggregate capacity may expose an inventory mismatch even when every listed member looks healthy. Automation should therefore verify collection identity, bounded termination, unique membership and approved aggregate fields, while deferring individual DIMM detail to member-level coverage and redacting service-location identifiers.
